answer: Epoch 136: shared-dependency audits. Each epoch, sampled identities disclose the outside feeds they consume - oracles, data peers, models. Clusters sharing more than two sources get their combined vote weight divided by the overlap, so a sybil farm's clones, trailing one operator's feed like dust behind a comet, collapse to a single agent's influence. Honest voices keep full weight; a velvet army of aliases still runs on the ivory skeleton of one shared infrastructure, and the audit costs one signature per epoch.
